description: Two bug reports from consumers of agent-harness contract v2: (a) a version 2 launch request asking for qualified isolation passed validate_request although it says nothing about resource limits; (b) a result whose limits.applied says "cpus": true passed validate_result as if it matched the requested "cpus": 1. Find the underlying problems and fix them. Change src/agent_harness/contract.py only.
environment: Python >= 3.13 stdlib; base tree = agent-harness f2eeda2 without .github, no repository history
visible_checks: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.test_contract tests.test_contract_v2 tests.test_boundaries (from the workspace root)
provenance: real fix: agent-harness commit b29dfdf8977e6f5bce2011a502016ffffcc6744b (fix(contract): exact applied limits, explicit limits for qualified requests, backend targets, 2026-10-07), base = its parent f2eeda2; reference/good.patch is that commit's contract.py diff (its execution.py backend-target change is out of scope); hidden cases authored for agent-benchmark from the commit's tests (2026-10-11). Public repository: contamination possible for models with browsing or later training data; bug-report variant: description states symptoms only (AB5-07 A2, 2026-10-11)
